jd.job_title: Senior Development Test Engineer — Pre & Post-Silicon Software Test, Validation and Characterization
required_skills: Advanced C and Python (bare-metal test content, hardware abstraction, automation frameworks)
8-10+ years post-silicon validation, system software testing, silicon bring-up, or development test for complex SoCs/ASICs/GPUs
Silicon Characterization (Shmoo plotting, PVT corner testing, jitter/margin analysis, guard-band definition)
Fault Injection expertise (hands-on experience building or executing error-injection and recovery validation campaigns)
Lab Instrumentation (oscilloscopes, protocol analyzers PCIe/CXL, logic analyzers, BERTs, thermal chambers, controllable power supplies, JTAG debuggers)
High-speed and System Protocols (practical understanding of PCIe, CXL, UCIe, I2C, SPI, UART, PMBus, SMBus)
Power Systems (sequencing, PMIC telemetry, DVFS, voltage regulation, protection trip limits)
Toolchains and CI (Git, CMake, GCC/Clang, CI pipelines) and statistics/data analysis
BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience
AI Tool usage (AI coding and automation tools must)
preferred_skills: Statistical analysis and machine learning applied to test data for outlier detection and predictive signals
Bare-metal exercisers, traffic generators, stress patterns, and custom firmware drivers
Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) CI/CD integration for continuous validation
Firmware error handlers, watchdog timers, hardware-level fault containment validation
key_responsibilities: Own end-to-end testing, characterization, and failure analysis strategy for complex, next-generation multi-die packages
Own complete validation lifecycle across multi-die architecture covering high-speed die-to-die interconnects, Power Delivery Networks, Platform Management Controllers, PCIe/CXL subsystems
Define development test strategies, coverage targets, content architecture with strict traceability from architectural requirements to validation evidence
Write low-level C and Python test suites including bare-metal exercisers, traffic generators, stress patterns, and custom firmware drivers/hooks
Build robust test frameworks featuring instrument control, automated sequencing, structured result capture, and Hardware-in-the-Loop CI/CD integration
Develop lab-to-ATE correlation test suites and drive smooth handoffs to Product & Test Engineering
Build minimally invasive fault-injection hardware/software infrastructure
Execute rigorous error campaigns targeting CRC retries, lane degradation, sideband timeouts, PCIe AER, DMA/IOMMU translation faults, PMIC reset conditions
Validate system firmware error handlers, watchdog timers, and hardware-level fault containment behavior under out-of-spec conditions
Apply statistical analysis and machine learning to test data for outlier detection, bench-to-ATE correlation, and predictive telemetry signals

adjacent.you_have: Git experience and embedded systems development
ML model evaluation, optimization (quantization, pruning), and benchmarking
Bare-metal C/C++ and RTOS (FreeRTOS) embedded systems experience
I2C, SPI, UART protocol implementation; lacks high-speed serializer exposure (PCIe/CXL/UCIe)

missing: 8-10+ years post-silicon validation or silicon bring-up experience (candidate: 0 full-time years, new-grad)
Silicon Characterization (Shmoo plotting, PVT corner testing, jitter/margin analysis, guard-band definition)
Fault Injection framework design and execution on production silicon
Thermal chambers and environmental test equipment control
Controllable power supplies and instrumentation software control
